subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96a1a85f20934a84fd262582522952386f154cae6d2dd03b4a6956006f93fc12.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f440b3d896575f2555d93b66f2484a392499308b60d43ecd146a2a3213a80278.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c43cba1436961f3b01a23ef97173e4909867a4a4d8bfd3e14dd4c6e422805627.png] 

The straight lines are changing their position by moving in clockwise direction.

The dots are changing their position by moving in anti-clockwise direction.

Hence, ‘**option 3**’ is the correct answer.
